newsitem.title: USA: Top U.S. boy scout arrested on weapons charges.
newsitem.headline: Top U.S. boy scout arrested on weapons charges.

text.p: The number one Boy Scout in the United States was arrested in Miami and accused with trying to bring a loaded revolver onto an aircraft headed for Jacksonville, police said Monday.
Jere Ratcliffe, chief executive of the Boy Scouts of America, was arrested Sunday morning after he placed a carry-on bag on a security scanner and workers saw the silhouette of the handgun inside.
He was arrested and told police he had forgotten he was carrying the loaded .32-calibre revolver.
"Mr. Ratcliffe stated that he was scheduled to depart on Air South (Flight) 538 to Jacksonville ...," the police report said. "He stated that he forgot the pistol."
The weapon was impounded and Ratcliffe was arrested and charged with carrying a concealed firearm.
A spokesman for the Metro-Dade Police Department said he believed Ratcliffe had bonded out of custody by mid-morning on Monday.
